clinical_intent: A patient receives a vaginal cuff brachytherapy boost of 15 Gy in 5 fractions following 50 Gy of EBRT. The vaginal cylinder has a diameter of 2.5 cm and the prescribed depth is 5 mm. Calculate the D2cc to the rectum and sigmoid from the brachytherapy boost alone using published dose-volume data for similar cylinder sizes. Then calculate the cumulative EQD2 to these organs from both EBRT and brachytherapy.
